title: SPACE Project (v2)
description: Config-driven description of a room-layout optimization project. Everything the layout needs is pure data: the room shape and scale, a machine-type library, placed machine instances, adjacency rules, objective weights, and rule modes. A rectangle with editable width/height is the common case; preset (L/T) and arbitrary polygons serialize through the same `room` object. Coordinate convention: all in-room geometry is normalized stage percent (0..100 of the stage box); real-unit values (feet/meters) are derived via `room.scale`. Forward-looking fields (per-machine footprint/clearance polygons, hazard flags, power, adjacency, ruleModes, objectiveWeights) are part of the schema but are NOT YET consumed by the v1 engine — see V2_COUPLING.md.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of THIS schema. V0 emits 2.0.0; E1 adds optional element attributes at 2.1.0; N1 adds the adjacency-override block at 2.2.0; L1 adds the optional amenity-link-override block at 2.3.0 (an earlier project omitting these validates and behaves identically).

room.description: The room the layout lives in: its shape, scale, and floor outline.

shape.description: rectangle: full-stage box. preset: a named parametric shape (L, T). polygon: explicit outline in `polygonPct`.

polygonPct.description: Required when shape=polygon. Room outline as normalized stage-% points (0..100), CCW or CW. Passed verbatim to the engine's structural floor element.

widthUnits.description: Stage width in real units (bounding box).

heightUnits.description: Stage height in real units (bounding box).

stage.description: Stage pixel dimensions. If omitted, derived as pxPerUnit * {width,height}Units. Given explicitly for the frozen pin to avoid float rounding.

floorId.description: Id assigned to the structural floor element. Must be distinct from all machine ids.

structuralBlockers.description: Structural elements beyond the floor (e.g. a wall filling an excluded notch, or interior walls). The objective grids treat these as walls: ADA/egress block their cells and noise rasterizes them into the STC grid. Each carries its own zone rectangle.

id.description: Unique id (distinct from machines and the floor).

verticesUnits.description: Documentation only: room outline in real units. Not consumed.

machineTypes.description: Library of machine/element TYPES keyed by type id. Shared attributes; instances reference a type and add position + optional overrides.

machines.description: Placed machine INSTANCES, in evaluation order (order flows into the engine's zone list).

movableIds.description: Machine ids the optimizer may relocate/rotate. Others are fixed obstacles.

objectiveWeights.description: Relative objective weights. NOTE: the current MOSA optimizer uses randomized-weight SA and does NOT consume these; retained for a future weighted-scalar report and weight-driven objective. See V2_COUPLING.md.

seed.description: PRNG seed. Hex string ("0x4D524443") or integer.

structuralGeometry.description: v2 Phase G1 (GEOMETRY ONLY, not yet read by the v1 engine — the seam ignores it, so the frozen pin is unaffected). Walls, doors, floors and zones LINKED BY REFERENCE, forming closed calculable rooms. A wall is a segment; a door is a permeable wall segment (walkThrough) that still bounds a zone but is an opening; a floor is the region bounded by a zone's closed loop; a zone is an enclosed area. Zones/floors are usually the OUTPUT of v2/zone-detection.mjs but may also be authored/corrected here. Coordinates are stage-% (0..100); real-unit areas derive via room.scale.

walls.description: Wall segments. Segments sharing an endpoint (within snap tolerance) form the wall graph whose closed loops are zones.

doors.description: Doors: permeable wall segments. Each references the wall it lies on (or carries its own endpoints) and connects zone(s) or a zone to outside.

floors.description: Floors: a region bounded by a closed loop of wall/door segments (1:1 with a zone in G1).

zones.description: Enclosed zones. Each knows its bounding walls (boundary) and its doors, plus a per-zone attribute bag reserved for later sim use.

adjacency.description: Pairwise adjacency overrides (v2 Phase N1). CONSUMED by the `adjacency` MOSA objective, which resolves each machine pair as: this array (user override) > built-in explicit defaults > rule-derived hazard defaults > NEUTRAL. Optional; an absent/empty array leaves the built-in defaults in force. See v2/ADJACENCY.md and v2/adjacency-defaults.json.

amenityLinks.description: Amenity-link OVERRIDES (v2 Phase L1, schema 2.3.0). CONSUMED by the `amenityLinks` MOSA objective, which resolves each machine->amenity requirement as: this array (user override, matched by `machine` id/type + amenityType) > the machine type's own amenityLinks > rule-derived (hazard/ventilation flags, v2/amenity-link-defaults.json) > none. Optional and inert by default; an absent array leaves the built-in + rule-derived links in force. See v2/AMENITY_LINKS.md.

ruleModes.description: Global rule strictness. Forward-looking: not yet consumed by the engine.

machineType.description: A reusable machine/element type. Engine-consumed fields (V0): label, short, risk, fixed, cat, beginner, w, h, dba_active, and (when a structural element) elementClass/subtype/blocksMovement/schedule_prob. Forward-looking fields are documented but not yet read.

label.description: Display name. Also used by ADA door-width checks (label containing 'exit').

risk.description: Risk score 0..5 (used by scoring; not by the sim objectives).

fixed.description: If true, the instance is locked (not movable).

cat.description: Category tag the engine keys off: 'exit' (egress seed), 'corridor'/'open' (excluded from the movable pool), 'structural-wall'/'wall' (solid), 'structural-door'/'door', 'structural-floor'. Empty/other => solid equipment.

dba_active.description: Operating sound level at 1 m (dBA). Zones below NOISE_AMBIENT_DBA (40) are non-emitters. Absent => non-emitter.

schedule_prob.description: Duty-cycle probability for the noise Monte Carlo. Absent => engine default.

blocksMovement.description: Explicit ADA/egress blocking override (wins over cat).

footprintPolygon.description: FORWARD-LOOKING (not yet consumed): true footprint outline in local %, for non-rectangular machines. V0 uses the w/h rectangle.

clearanceZones.description: E1 (v2.1.0) FORWARD-LOOKING first-class rotation-aware directional clearance zones (operator envelope, infeed/outfeed corridor, maintenance access, kickback cone, spark arc, door swing). Each rotates with the machine. See v2/ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTES.md (d).

hazards.description: E1 (v2.1.0) FORWARD-LOOKING hazard flags for future adjacency/separation objectives. Independent booleans (a machine may carry several at once); absent object or absent flag => false => no hazard declared => inert. See v2/ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTES.md (a).

vibrationSource.description: Vibration source (no governing standard — design assumption).

dust.description: DEPRECATED alias of dustProducing (v2.0.0 stub retained for back-compat).

spark.description: DEPRECATED alias of sparkSource (v2.0.0 stub retained).

wet.description: DEPRECATED alias of wetProcess (v2.0.0 stub retained).

power.description: E1 FORWARD-LOOKING electrical requirements (nameplate; design assumption in the library).

ventilation.description: E1 FORWARD-LOOKING ventilation requirements (OSHA 1910.94; ACGIH Industrial Ventilation). Absent => none required => inert.

cfm.description: Exhaust airflow (ft^3/min) if known; null => unknown (design assumption).

requiresExteriorWallOrDuct.description: Must sit on an exterior wall or a duct drop (laser/welding exhaust).

utilities.description: E1 FORWARD-LOOKING utility requirements. Absent => none => inert.

amenityLinks.description: E1 FORWARD-LOOKING typed links from this machine to a required amenity type, each with a max distance/travel-time and a mode (Dr. Jariwala's user-definable typed-linkage design). Absent => no links => inert. See v2/ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTES.md (e).

occupancy.description: E1 FORWARD-LOOKING occupancy for a future active-users metric. Defaults are inert.

personSpaceAreaUnits.description: Person-space area per operator (real units^2; design assumption).

footprintsMayOverlap.description: Whether operator footprints may overlap neighbors.

principalAxis.description: Machine principal axis (rotation reference), consumed by scoring.js for vector/footprint rotation. RETAINED as-is; clearanceZones orientation is defined relative to it.

operatorFootprints.description: Operator risk-zone footprints (rotation-aware), consumed by scoring.js. RETAINED. Each entry { type, offsetX, offsetY, ... } in stage-%.

kickbackVectors.description: EXISTING cone vectors consumed by scoring.js _scVectorConflicts (metrics/flags, NOT evaluateLayout). RETAINED. Each { type:'vector', offsetX, offsetY, angle, angleSpread }. The new clearanceZones (type kickbackCone) is a superset; keep a declared pair consistent (see ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTES.md (d) + GAPS).

materialVectors.description: EXISTING material-ejection cone vectors consumed by scoring.js. RETAINED (see kickbackVectors).

id.description: Unique instance id (also the engine zone id).

x.description: Top-left x, stage %. Default 50 if omitted.

y.description: Top-left y, stage %. Default 50 if omitted.

rotation.description: Rotation degrees about the footprint center. Default 0.

included.description: FORWARD-LOOKING per-instance include toggle (V0 always true).

clearanceZone.description: E1 (v2.1.0) FORWARD-LOOKING first-class, rotation-aware, DIRECTIONAL clearance zone. Geometry is a parametric template OR an explicit machine-local polygon; orientation is relative to the machine's principal axis so it rotates with the machine (same convention as scoring.js). NOT consumed by any objective yet. See v2/ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTES.md (d). Back-compat: the v2.0.0 stub fields (direction/polygon/mode) are still accepted.

geometry.description: Parametric template OR explicit machine-local polygon. Distances are real units (room.scale.unit).

template.description: rect: {offsetUnits, alongUnits, acrossUnits}. cone: {apexOffsetUnits, spreadDeg, lengthUnits}.

points.description: kind=polygon: machine-local coords (real units), x along the principal axis.

orientation.description: Orientation relative to the machine principal axis (rotates with the machine).

angleDeg.description: Zone direction offset from the principal axis, degrees.

provenance.description: Standard clause, published measurement, or 'design assumption'.

amenityLink.description: Typed link: a machine requires an amenity of amenityType within a max distance or travel time. E1 defined it on machineTypes; L1 (schema 2.3.0) CONSUMES it via the `amenityLinks` MOSA objective (v2/amenity-links.mjs). Two uses: on a machineType (that machine's built-in required links) and in the project-level `amenityLinks` array (a per-(machine,amenityType) OVERRIDE carrying a `machine` id/type). Path-based types (eyewash/fireExtinguisher) use engine-grid walking travel; others straight-line. See v2/AMENITY_LINKS.md.

machine.description: Project-override only: the machine id or type this override applies to (ignored on a machineType's own amenityLinks).

maxDistanceUnits.description: Max travel distance in real units (null => use maxTravelSeconds or unspecified).

maxTravelSeconds.description: Max travel time in seconds (e.g. eyewash 10 s per ANSI Z358.1).

provenance.description: Standard clause (ANSI Z358.1, NFPA 10, ...) or 'design assumption'. REQUIRED.

adjacencyRule.description: Pairwise adjacency relationship / override (v2 Phase N1, schema 2.2.0). CONSUMED by the `adjacency` MOSA objective (v2/adjacency.mjs). A project entry OVERRIDES the built-in rule-derived + explicit defaults for the named pair (precedence: user override > explicit default > rule-derived > NEUTRAL). Match is by machine `type` pair or instance `id` pair, unordered unless `directed`. The legacy relation/distanceUnits fields remain accepted. Every override SHOULD carry `provenance`.

level.description: N1 relationship level. Overrides all defaults for this pair.

requiredSeparationUnits.description: Required separation (real units) for PROHIBITED/DISCOURAGED, or ideal adjacency distance for SYNERGISTIC. Omitted => level default (35/10/5 ft).

mode.description: N1: both contribute a penalty, strict weighted 5x (hard rejection deferred to R1). Omitted => level default (PROHIBITED->strict, else advisory).

directed.description: true => applies only to the ordered (a,b) pair (asymmetric); default symmetric.

provenance.description: Standard clause or 'design assumption' or a user note. Required in spirit; the objective records it in diagnostics for auditability.

relation.description: LEGACY (pre-N1) relation form; still accepted, superseded by `level`.

wallSegment.description: A wall segment between two endpoints (stage-%). Endpoints shared with other segments (within snapTol) knit the wall graph together.

id.description: Unique wall id (referenced by doors, floors, zones).

stc.description: Sound Transmission Class / attenuation (dB). For later noise use; not consumed in G1.

blocksMovement.description: Whether the wall blocks circulation. Default true.

doorSegment.description: A door: a permeable wall segment. It bounds a zone (for area/loop purposes) but is flagged as an opening. References the wall it lies on (or carries its own endpoints).

wall.description: Id of the wall this door lies on (the wall is carved wall|door|wall). Optional if the door carries its own endpoints.

walkThrough.description: A door is permeable. Default true.

width.description: Clear opening width in real units (for later ADA/egress use).

role.description: interior-bridge: between two zones. exit-to-outside: on the outer contour. May be authored; the detector also computes it from which faces the door borders.

zones.description: Zone id(s) this door connects (1 for an exit, 2 for an interior bridge). Populated by the detector.

floorRegion.description: A floor: the region bounded by a closed loop of wall/door segments. 1:1 with a zone in G1.

zoneId.description: The zone this floor is the region of.

loop.description: Ordered closed loop of wall/door segment ids bounding the region.

zoneRegion.description: An enclosed zone. Knows its bounding walls (boundary) and doors; carries a per-zone attribute bag reserved for later sim use (noise/dust/etc), empty-but-present now.

boundary.description: Ordered loop of wall/door segment ids that enclose this zone.

doors.description: Door ids on this zone's boundary.

areaUnits.description: Computed area in real units^2 via room.scale.

isRoom.description: false if a user marked this detected zone as not-a-room.

attributes.description: Per-zone attribute bag for later sim use (noise/dust/occupancy/etc). Empty-but-present in G1; no simulation reads it yet.
